description: The agent ingests file-based data (like audio MP3s for transcription and Boggle grids for word validation) and browses web-sourced dictionaries (e.g., raw GitHub text files). It executes Python code for puzzle solving (like recursive DFS for Boggle) and audio processing (like speech-to-text for identifying page numbers). The agent filters and validates against an exact dictionary, ensuring case-insensitive matches and excluding proper nouns if specified, outputting strictly formatted results such as the longest word or ascending comma-separated lists without extraneous text.

tools.name: FileIO
tools.description: Handles reading and writing of file-based data, including audio files and text documents.

tools.name: WebBrowser
tools.description: Allows the agent to browse the web and access online dictionaries or resources for data extraction.

tools.name: PythonExecutor
tools.description: Executes Python code for solving puzzles, processing data, and performing computations.

tools.name: AudioProcessor
tools.description: Processes audio data for transcription and extraction, converting speech to text.

tools.name: DictionaryValidator
tools.description: Validates words against specified dictionaries, ensuring case-insensitive matches and filtering as needed.
